description: This file defines React components for dropdown menus, including styled components and dropdown variants with icons and animations, used within the Superset UI project.

methods.name: RenderIcon
methods.description: Returns an icon component based on the specified orientation.

methods.name: MenuDotsDropdown
methods.description: A dropdown component with a styled 'menu dots' icon, supporting different icon orientations.

methods.name: NoAnimationDropdown
methods.description: A dropdown component that clones its child element to add event handlers, with no animation.

methods.name: Dropdown
methods.description: A simple wrapper around antd's Dropdown component with autoFocus enabled.
